ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.orderData[0]."Orden_Activacion".Servicios filter ((item, index) -> item.Nombre == "ACCESO DE RED")

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- flatten((vars.orderData[0].'Orden_Activacion'.Servicios filter ((s, index) -> s.Nombre == "ACCESO DE RED")).'Servicios_Hijos') filter ((sh, index) -> sh.Nombre == "ONT/DSL") default []
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload[0 to (sizeOf(payload) as Number - 1)] map { status : $."$$".response[0].status, description: $."$$".response[0].description }

%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Arrays output application/json var serviceIndex = indexOf(vars.orderData[0].'Orden_Activacion'.Servicios.Nombre, "ACCESO DE RED") var childServiceIdx = indexOf(vars.orderData[0].'Orden_Activacion'.Servicios[serviceIndex].Servicios_Hijos.Nombre, "ONT/DSL") --- { "serial": vars.inputPayload.serial default "", "transactionType": lower(vars.inputPayload.transactType), "ontType": vars.ontType, "serviceIndex": serviceIndex, "childServiceIndex": childServiceIdx, "codeService": p('mongo-sapi-services.orders.rollbackProcess'), "descriptionService": (vars.statusDescription filter $.status == p('mongo-sapi-services.orders.rollbackProcess')).description[0], "codeOrder": p('mongo-sapi-services.orders.activationProcess'), "descriptionOrder": (vars.statusDescription filter $.status == p('mongo-sapi-services.orders.activationProcess')).description[0], "errorProvisioning": vars.errorProvisioning, ("serialOld": vars.inputPayload.serialOld) if (!isBlank(vars.inputPayload.serialOld)), ("ontTypeOld": vars.inputPayload.ontTypeOld) if (!isBlank(vars.inputPayload.ontTypeOld)) }
%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = vars.orquestadorProvisioningResponse.Resultado.Encabezado.Servicio.Estado --- if(status == "OK") 201 else 500
%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = vars.orquestadorProvisioningResponse.Resultado.Encabezado.Servicio.Estado --- if(status == "OK") 201 else 500

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ((vars.ordenComercial == 'O90') and (vars.ordenServicio == '160') and (vars.ordenActivacion == '30') and (vars.servicioAcceso == '40')) 'unchanged' else 'changed'
%dw 2.0 output application/json import wait from dw::Runtime --- "First round of checking states" wait 10000
